dataset: CRUW/ROD2021 public training sequences with synchronized RGB and RA
purpose: all-scene training of the canonical DREAM-BEV anchor and presence sentinel, followed by single-person expert and radar-vision fusion adaptation

canonical_bev.outside_fov_policy: Retain the input frame but do not clamp an outside-FOV pedestrian into the BEV border. Presence and localization supervision refer only to pedestrians inside the canonical BEV.

split_rule: A source sequence belongs to exactly one split. Development sequences are rejected by every training entry point.
fit_scene_scope: Empty, single-pedestrian, multi-pedestrian, distractor-rich and short-fragment frames are retained whenever synchronized RGB and four RA chirps exist.
development_role: Development-only selection and evaluation. No CRUW official test or leaderboard claim is made.
